name: ratelimit
title: Rate limit
description: Durable, ORM-backed rate limiting (token-bucket / fixed-window / sliding-window) wired into your Lunora schema and procedures.
docs: Attach the middleware with c.mutation.use(ratelimit.middleware), or .use(rateLimit(limiter, name, { key: (ctx) => ctx.auth.userId ?? ctx.ip ?? "anon" })) on the procedures you want limited — always derive the key server-side, never from args. Configure named limits in lunora/ratelimit/schema.ts. The scaffolded consume/check/reset are internal (server-only) on purpose: they take the bucket key from their caller, so as public RPC reset would let anyone nullify every limit and consume would let anyone lock a known victim out.
